scope: Synthetic disposable NEW Core native composition; not production shell acceptance

owners.ingress: Durable exact media command journal; no semantic reducer

requirements: One marked session binds exactly one factory-created disposable Space; app-closed CLI/MCP use the same service
Browser bundle excludes Node/filesystem/SQL/Buffer dependencies; root envelope shared and SHA verified before decoding
Media command+bytes journaled and flushed before UI protection acknowledgement; replay unchanged through Core
Close/reload refused if media ingress is not durable or editor prepareClose fails; freeze input during guard
Same-session reopen uses original bundle/store; no reset/new-space substitution after failure
Native PDFKit preview uses only synthetic Core-read PDF bytes, no filesystem URL; image object URLs revoked on replacement/detach
Main navigation restricted; bootstrap installed at document start and renewed on service reconnect
Reports separate automated helper, user verdict and actual Mac compile/run; private tokens/descriptors excluded

manualCases.title: Two views and context history
manualCases.expected: Edits converge; undo reverses only that context; remount preserves history
steps: Type LOCAL before Alpha in A. Confirm B updates. Type FOREIGN in B. Use Undo A / Redo A; FOREIGN must remain. Close/reopen view A once and repeat undo. Record the result before moving on.

manualCases.title: Image cover and native PDF
manualCases.expected: Synthetic image/cover visible; PDF opens native preview; replacement retains historical bytes
steps: Add sample image, Set/replace cover, Add sample PDF. Both views must show the image/cover. Open native PDF: a PDFKit window must show the synthetic page. Replace cover once. No real/private files.

manualCases.title: Pending media close and journal failure
manualCases.expected: Durable queued media survives close/reopen/restart; failed journal refuses close/reload
steps: Enable Fail media and Fail journal. Click Add sample image, then red close or Reload. It must refuse and keep the app. Disable Fail journal (keep Fail media), retry protected media, then close. Reopen same session; protected work must remain. Disable Fail media and retry. Do not type during this case; conflict UI is not included.

manualCases.title: Protected text and app-closed client
manualCases.expected: Failed saves protect or refuse close; same-session recovery and CLI read retain work
steps: Enable Fail saves + Fail protection; type PROTECTED in A. Red close must refuse. Disable Fail protection, close, reopen SAME session, click Recover protected A. Clear Fail saves and save. Restart service once. Quit and use app-closed CLI read from the printed setup instructions.
